gui.skyabyss.trial.abyss.tip: Abyss: trial numbers go above Extreme, +3 materials, and the heart becomes the Heart of the Abyss. Chosen per group (a reborn member picks it; unreborn allies can join)
message.skyabyss.abyss.on: The abyss opens. Trials and the heart go one step deeper
message.skyabyss.abyss.off: The abyss closes. Trials return to their usual depth
message.skyabyss.abyss.locked: Only those reborn %s times can choose the abyss
abyss.skyabyss.title: Heart of the Abyss
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.whale: The whale's beat rings again from the very bottom
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.tide: The shell's tide rises where no light reaches
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.storm: The wing's thunder wakes behind the dark clouds
abyss.skyabyss.subtitle.ember: The ember's fire burns black beneath the ash
message.skyabyss.abyss.legend_dupe: The relic you already own turned into resonance shards
item.skyabyss.abyss_greatsword.desc: A greatsword with a bottomless blade. The line it cuts splits again, a moment later
item.skyabyss.abyss_bell_staff.desc: A staff hung with a sunken bell. The ward it rings sinks, then returns
item.skyabyss.abyss_bell_staff.story: "A bell rings best at the bottom of the water."
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_bow.desc: A bow bent at the floor of a thundercloud. Lightning follows to wherever the arrow stops
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_bow.story: "Thunder draws one deep breath before it falls."
item.skyabyss.abyss_ash_scythe.desc: A scythe that reaps ash. The ash it leaves creeps to the next foe
legend.skyabyss.abyss_cleave.effect: The fan you cut splits again 1.2 s later; a delayed blade at x0.6 hits whoever is still inside.
legend.skyabyss.sunk_song.effect: Ward left unbroken sinks into health when the song ends. The most wounded ally also receives half of the total.
legend.skyabyss.sky_fall.effect: 0.8 s after the arrow stops, a pillar of lightning falls there (radius 2.5, x0.9 attack).
legend.skyabyss.creeping_ash.effect: Ash spreads every 2 s to foes within 4 blocks of an ashed foe (up to 3 times).
